# Research or foundation change

## What question or problem does this address?

Link the bounded task and relevant department or agenda question.

## What changed and why?

Summarize the result and its effect on the vision, shared context, or research direction.

## Evidence and verification

State sources, calculations/checks actually used, and important limits. Separate assumptions from findings.

## Shared context and review

Link work-log closure and any status, assumption, decision, or handoff updates. Identify unresolved disagreements or operator decisions. Confirm public content contains no private records or credentials.
